profiles.purpose: Fresh valid-schema characterization: successive owner corrections, separate knowledge cutoff, lexical/numeric identity distractors, independent-source conflict, and bounded public read cost.
Previously frozen B5 historical-scale and old-target replay control.
Existing contradiction, identity, and temporal regression control.

frozen_acceptance.byte_policy: Record compact serialized JSON-RPC response bytes per scored read; the public contract has no separate fixed assemble_context output-byte ceiling.
frozen_acceptance.latency_policy: Report each scored assemble_context round-trip latency in microseconds and each whole-case runtime in milliseconds; summarize distributions independently from correctness.
frozen_acceptance.decision_policy: Score registered source set, assertions, disposition, roles, contradiction outcome, valid-time cutoff, knowledge-revision boundary, and exact identity. Do not change the oracle after opening captures.
frozen_acceptance.repeatability_policy: Compare normalized decision replays for every first/repeat pair; elapsed timing is descriptive and is not part of replay equality.
frozen_acceptance.interpretation: Local deterministic characterization only. No population claim, agent-utility claim, or product-change claim unless a valid frozen oracle fails on the unchanged product binary. Preserve the malformed v1 capture but exclude it from product-defect scoring.

preflight_note: An initial invocation was rejected during input validation because the independent conflict probe declared expected conflict roles without requires_separate_time_cutoffs. It reported no suites to run and wrote no capture. The missing field was added, the probe hash updated, and this registration re-frozen before the first scored run.

Before any valid capture, two unscored runner preflights were rejected. The first had malformed probe metadata and ran no suites; the corrected probe was re-frozen with its updated checksum. The next invocation wrote only an INVALID report because product revision and absolute artifact root environment variables were missing; all four cases were invalid and no scored replay ran. The actual capture commands above include both required variables and each uses a fresh root.
